name: JEP 527 - Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Exchange for TLS 1.3
dscr: TLS 1.3 key exchange that combines quantum-resistant ML-KEM with classic elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman, used by default through the X25519MLKEM768 named group.

name: JEP 531 - Lazy Constants (Third Preview)
dscr: Lazy Constants offer an immutable data abstraction for performance and safety, now completed with a lazy Set factory.

name: JEP 533 - Structured Concurrency (Seventh Preview)
dscr: Structured concurrency simplifies concurrent programming by treating groups of related tasks running in different threads as a single unit of work.

name: JEP 537 - Vector API (Twelfth Incubator)
dscr: API for expressing vector computations that reliably compile at runtime to optimal vector instructions on supported CPUs to achieve better performance.

name: JEP 538 - PEM Encodings of Cryptographic Objects (Third Preview)
dscr: API for encoding keys, certificates, and certificate revocation lists as PEM text and decoding them back, including password-protected private keys.
